name: revealProjectFolder
description: Reveal a project folder in the native OS file manager (Explorer / Finder) via platform_util::ShowItemInFolder, for the composer folder chip's 'Show in Explorer' action. Test seam: when the NEXUS_E2E_REVEAL_SINK environment variable is set, the handler writes the path to that file instead of opening the file manager (Playwright cannot observe a native OS window).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Absolute path of the folder to reveal.
